table desk nr num 1..20, name text
grid 5 gap 1
  each 1..20 as n
    box height 54 radius 8 fill if(count(desk where nr = n) > 0, accent, soft) tap edit last(desk where nr = n)
      n tiny
      last(desk.name where nr = n) small bold
form desk, "Seat a student"
"Seated" count(desk) "of 20" faint
after:
app "Seating" seat slate
table desk nr num 1..20, name text
grid 5 gap 1
  each 1..20 as n
    box height 54 radius 8 fill if(count(desk where nr = n) > 0, accent, soft) tap edit last(desk where nr = n)
      n tiny
      last(desk.name where nr = n) small bold
form desk, "Seat a student"
"Seated" count(desk) "of 20" faint
"Empty desks" 20 - count(desk) faint
hurried_style: terse like a search query, 2 to 6 words
fuller_style: a sentence then a list of what is wanted, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the numbers or units

before:
app "Prayers on time" mosque ink
table prayer
setting target num = 35
let n = count(prayer today)
draw width 240 tap add prayer
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
button "Reset today" tap remove all prayer today
remind "Time for prayers" at 21:00
when n = target notify "Target reached"
after:
app "Prayers on time" mosque ink
table prayer
setting target num = 35
let n = count(prayer today)
draw width 240 tap add prayer
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
button "Reset today" tap remove all prayer today
daybars last 7 days, count(prayer on it)
remind "Time for prayers" at 21:00
when n = target notify "Target reached"
changes: adds: daybars last 7 days, count(prayer on it)
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with who it is for

before:
app "Study routine" school plum
table subject name text
table subject_done subject ref subject
let n = count(subject)
count(subject_done today) "of" n "done today" head
each subject
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
    toggle it.subject_done
form subject
stat max(subject, streak(it.subject_done)), "best streak"
heat last 70 days, count(subject_done on it), n
remind "Time to tick off study subjects" every 3h from 8:00 to 20:00
after:
app "Study routine" school mint
table subject name text
table subject_done subject ref subject
let n = count(subject)
count(subject_done today) "of" n "done today" head
each subject
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
    toggle it.subject_done
form subject
stat max(subject, streak(it.subject_done)), "best streak"
heat last 70 days, count(subject_done on it), n
remind "Time to tick off study subjects" every 3h from 8:00 to 20:00

before:
app "Shopping" bag ink
table purchase what text, amount money
state m date = today
let spent = sum(purchase.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 20000 "Monthly budget"
monthnav m
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form purchase
list purchase month of m by day
